_doc: The scripted captain's Tractor scene (the battle console mockup's scene_tractor): lock the ship astern, open the ship panel's Tractor page, Hold, wait out the power-up, then run at full speed so the tow drags the held ship into the rock between them. Played from every side (concord_tractor, krai_tractor, kelvane_tractor, ssarith_tractor).
